tool_args.command:
cat << 'PYEOF' | python3
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

depth_pairs = ['d0→d1', 'd1→d2', 'd2→d3', 'd3→d4', 'd4→d5']
x = np.arange(len(depth_pairs))

binary_mean = [0.9975, 0.9250, 0.8225, 0.7837, 0.6832]
binary_ci_lo = [0.995,  0.9138, 0.8052, 0.7648, 0.6611]
binary_ci_hi = [1.000,  0.9354, 0.8402, 0.8024, 0.7045]

fourclass = [0.9975, 0.8607, 0.8005, None, None]
sixclass = [0.9962, 0.8231, 0.6878, 0.6809, 0.6948]

thresholds = {'T=0.80': 0.80, 'T=0.75': 0.75, 'T=0.70': 0.70, 'T=0.65': 0.65}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

# Binary pairwise + CI band
ax.fill_between(x, binary_ci_lo, binary_ci_hi, color='#0072B2', alpha=0.2)
ax.plot(x, binary_mean, '-o', color='#0072B2', linewidth=2.0, markersize=6,
        label='Binary pairwise RF', zorder=5)

# 4-class (only first 3 points)
fc_x = [i for i, v in enumerate(fourclass) if v is not None]
fc_y = [v for v in fourclass if v is not None]
ax.plot(fc_x, fc_y, '--^', color='#E69F00', linewidth=1.5, markersize=6,
        label='4-class multiclass RF', zorder=4)

# 6-class
ax.plot(x, sixclass, ':s', color='#009E73', linewidth=1.5, markersize=5,
        label='6-class multiclass RF', zorder=4)

# Threshold lines
for label, val in thresholds.items():
    ax.axhline(y=val, color='gray', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, linewidth=0.8)
    ax.text(len(depth_pairs) - 0.5, val + 0.005, label, fontsize=9, color='gray',
            ha='left', va='bottom')

# EDD annotation
ax.axvline(x=3.5, color='#CC0000', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.7)
ax.axvspan(3.5, len(depth_pairs) - 0.5, alpha=0.08, color='red')
ax.text(3.55, 1.02, 'EDD=4', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#CC0000',
        ha='left', va='top')

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(depth_pairs)
ax.set_xlabel('Adjacent Depth Pair')
ax.set_ylabel('Pairwise AUC')
ax.set_ylim(0.55, 1.05)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, len(depth_pairs) - 0.5)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9)
ax.grid(alpha=0.2)

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513_2/projects/recursive_gen_depth_est/figures/paper'
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_auc_decay.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig_auc_decay.png')
plt.close()

import os
pdf_size = os.path.getsize(f'{out_dir}/fig_auc_decay.pdf')
png_size = os.path.getsize(f'{out_dir}/fig_auc_decay.png')
print(f'PDF: {pdf_size/1024:.1f} KB, PNG: {png_size/1024:.1f} KB')
assert pdf_size > 10240, f'PDF too small: {pdf_size}'
print('OK')
PYEOF

图表确认正确：

- Binary pairwise RF 带 95% CI shaded band（蓝色半透明区域）
- d3→d4 CI 下界 (0.765) 明显高于 T=0.75 线，视觉上支持 EDD=4
- 4-class 只画了前 3 个点，6-class 全 5 个点
- EDD=4 红色竖线和浅红背景区域已标注
- 阈值标签在右侧，无标题，spines 已移除
